amendment.change_scope: year handling only. Population, targets, routing, title metric, thresholds, controls, budget, stopping rule and falsifiers are unchanged from v1.
amendment.pilot_data_reuse: none: the v2 table is rebuilt from fresh bodies in raw/; no pilot fetch is copied into the v2 evidence
amendment.pilot_v1_scope: 13 of 34 rows, 26 fetches, 2026-09-12T00:43-00:45; stopped before completion; raw bodies retained under pilot_v1_superseded/raw/ for audit but EXCLUDED from every v2 count and verdict
amendment.reason: Comparator defect observed in the pilot: arXiv Atom <published> is the v1 preprint year while the ledger year is the journal publication year, so SRC-004 (title containment 1.0, arXiv published 2017 vs ledger 2025) was classified PARTIAL and SRC-024's replacement (containment 1.0, arXiv 2020 vs ledger 2022) likewise; the v1 implementation also deviated from the v1 text (>2 year delta did not force MISMATCH). The pilot was stopped before more fetches and this v2 rule was frozen before any v2 fetch.
amendment.v2_year_rule: arXiv-derived years (published/updated/journal_ref) are preprint/version years, not journal publication years; for arXiv sources the year is advisory and identity rests on title containment. Journal-indexed sources (Crossref, OpenAlex, INSPIRE) still carry the decisive year rule.

authority: Worker evidence only. Not a ledger edit, not a G-LIT gate verdict, not an L1 node completion, not a validation_status. The canonical ledger remains owned by astra-lead-literature; any repair requires a controller freeze decision because it moves the L1 hash.

C1_positive_penrose_1965.expected: single record, title containment >= 0.75 against 'Gravitational collapse and space-time singularities'

C2_negative_mutants.expected: neither returns a record matching its reference title; both must classify HTTP_ERROR or ZERO_RECORD, never MATCH

C3_cross_source.expected: both sources independently MATCH the ledger title for all 3 rows
C3_cross_source.fetch: both the arXiv id and the Crossref DOI per row
C3_cross_source.rows: the 3 lowest citation_id SCC rows with non-empty doi and arxiv_id and empty mirror_of

C4_hash_guard_teeth.test: a byte-mutated ledger copy must make the runner exit 3 before any fetch

C5_scope_and_disjointness.test: exactly 34 SCC rows, every one carries an SCC token, intersection with worker-050's 12 exact-match WCC locators is empty

C6_replay_determinism.test: re-run from cached raw bodies (--replay, no network) and compare all verdict fields

falsifiers: F1: any current exact_locator classified MULTI_RECORD/ZERO_RECORD that in fact resolves to exactly one record matching the cited work voids the 'weak' classification of that row.
F2: any proposed replacement classified VERIFIED_MISMATCH or FETCH_FAILED falsifies that repair proposal; a single VERIFIED_MISMATCH turns the table verdict to FAIL.
F3: any drift of ledger/citation_audit.csv away from sha256 315c19145065a5f9c95d64461eae760b4c296b06d1f2f09bc5847ac1a7064ce9 voids the whole table.
F4: any control (C1-C6) failing invalidates the instrument and voids the table verdict.
F5: an offline replay that produces different verdicts from the same raw bodies falsifies determinism.
F6: an independent comparator applied to the retained raw bodies that disagrees on a row verdict falsifies that row's verdict (raw bodies and hashes are retained for exactly this).
F7: a row matched on an arXiv title with an advisory year that a journal-indexed source later shows to be a different work falsifies that row's verdict.
next_falsifier: The frozen ledger itself is not edited by this task: after a controller freeze decision, apply the 26 verified replacements and re-run both this re-fetch and the frozen-hash spot checks against the new L1 hash.

population.cross_check: the citation_id set must equal the 34-row set in the pinned resolution.json; any difference aborts the run (exit 6)
population.rule: rows of ledger/citation_audit.csv whose class_mapping contains AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN or AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN

record_extraction.arxiv_api: feed <entry> count; title from <title>; year_candidates from <published>, <updated> and the year in <arxiv:journal_ref>; year_basis=arxiv_preprint
record_extraction.other_html: document <title>, og:title or citation_title if present

role: bounded execution worker (not the ledger author, not the G-LIT gate owner)

row_outputs.table_verdict: all 26 replacements VERIFIED_MATCH and all 8 direct locators SINGLE_RECORD_MATCH -> PASS; any VERIFIED_MISMATCH/HTTP_ERROR/SINGLE_RECORD_MISMATCH -> FAIL; otherwise PARTIAL

source_routing.arxiv_abs: https://arxiv.org/abs/<id> -> primary arXiv API https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list=<id>; fallback https://arxiv.org/abs/<id>
source_routing.arxiv_api_query: http(s)://export.arxiv.org/api/query?... -> fetch as-is; record the number of <entry> elements
source_routing.doi: https://doi.org/<doi> or bare DOI -> Crossref https://api.crossref.org/works/<doi>
source_routing.early_stop: stop fetching a replacement target once a SINGLE_RECORD title MATCH is obtained
source_routing.fallback_scope: fallbacks are used only for the proposed replacement; the current exact_locator is judged on its own bytes only, so a query feed cannot be rescued by another source
source_routing.note: routing is fixed before any fetch; the specific source used is recorded per fetch

stopping_rule.complete: every row has a verdict from at least one fetched source and all controls pass
stopping_rule.incomplete: more than 20% of rows are FETCH_FAILED for network reasons other than 404/410; report INCOMPLETE (exit 5) and do not issue a table verdict
stopping_rule.void: ledger or resolution.json bytes drift from the pins during the run; abort (exit 6)

targets_per_row.current_exact_locator: the exact_locator cell as published (all 34 rows)
targets_per_row.proposed_replacement: resolution.json proposed_exact_locator for the 26 weak rows; NOT_APPLICABLE for the 8 direct rows

task: Independent live re-fetch of every SCC-side locator in ledger/citation_audit.csv at the frozen L1 hash, testing the repair proposals emitted by W062-SCC-LOCATOR-RESOLVABILITY-01

verdict_rule.MATCH: single resolved record AND containment >= 0.75 AND the applicable year rule above
verdict_rule.MISMATCH: single resolved record AND (containment < 0.45, or publication-basis year delta > 2)
verdict_rule.MULTI_RECORD: response is a result list or feed with >= 2 records
verdict_rule.PARSE_ERROR: 2xx but the body cannot be parsed into records
verdict_rule.PARTIAL: single resolved record AND containment in [0.45,0.75), or publication-basis year delta == 2 with containment >= 0.75
verdict_rule.containment: |tokens(ledger_title) INTERSECT tokens(resolved_title)| / min(|tokens(ledger_title)|, |tokens(resolved_title)|); ledger-side parenthetical annotations are absorbed because the denominator is the smaller token set
verdict_rule.title_normalisation: lowercase; drop $...$ math; remove LaTeX backslash commands; keep [a-z0-9] tokens; collapse whitespace
verdict_rule.year_rule_arxiv_basis: arXiv years are preprint/version years: containment >= 0.75 -> MATCH with year_advisory=true unless some candidate year is within +/-1; the best delta is recorded for audit but does not block MATCH. Containment in [0.45,0.75) -> PARTIAL; < 0.45 -> MISMATCH.
verdict_rule.year_rule_publication_basis: when the resolved source exposes a publication year (Crossref/OpenAlex/INSPIRE): best |ledger_year - candidate_year| <= 1 -> MATCH; <= 2 -> PARTIAL; > 2 forces MISMATCH
